classes.label: Unresolved
classes.definition: Insufficient evidence to assign another scene class.

classes.label: Physical credential
classes.definition: The presented credential body, including its printing, portrait and protective surface; authenticity is not asserted.

classes.label: Paper reproduction
classes.definition: A printed or photocopied representation of a credential.

classes.label: Screen reproduction
classes.definition: The display area presenting a credential image on a monitor, phone or tablet.

classes.label: Supporting surface
classes.definition: Visible surroundings supporting the presented document, irrespective of material.

classes.label: Occluder
classes.definition: An object such as a finger covering the presented document.
